KyoubeAI 1.18.2 makes files you add to a new task show up in it, and lets you add files when you assign a task from an agent's profile.

## What's in 1.18.2

**Files on a new task show up.** The New task dialog (the sidebar's New Task, and Assign Task on an agent's page) uploaded your files to the task, but the task page showed none of them except `.md` and `.txt` files, which become task documents. They now arrive as the task's first message, so they show as files in its conversation.

**Assign task takes files.** The Assign task form on the Team page and on an agent's profile has an Add files button. The files go into the new task's first message the same way, up to 20 at a time. If one cannot be added, the confirmation names it so you can add it in the task's conversation. Kyoube Studio is 0.7.1.

## Update

From 1.18, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.18.1. There are no database migrations and nothing to set up.

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
